newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks up slightly by lunch as locals buy.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks up slightly by lunch as locals buy.

text.p: Some buying by locals offset several bouts of profit-taking and enabled Thai stocks to rise marginally in thin trade by the lunch break on Wednesday, brokers said.

"The market was sluggish during the morning session as investors stayed on the sidelines due to an absence of fresh funds and positive news to stimulate the market. Short-term local investors were active," said Padermpob Songkroh of Nava Finance and Securities.
The composite SET index gained 0.05 point to 691.21 on 932 million baht turnover by the lunch break.

Brokers said they expected the market to remain bearish during the afternoon session today because of persistent investor concerns over weak first quarter earnings of finance companies which were just released.
"Investors are waiting for the scheduled release of the country's key economic data by the central bank tomorrow before making their next move," Padermpob said.
Several key sectors dropped by lunch. The banking sector was first-ranked in terms of value, falling 0.08 percent.
Shinawatra Computer topped the active list, unchanged at 204 baht. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
